systems.system: Real property register (Real Property Tax Project)
systems.tiers: piloted in Margibi County from 15 December 2021 and rolled out to Buchanan, Grand Bassa County, in 2022, with 50% of revenue shared with the county; seven more counties planned over the strategy

note: The revenue authority's strategy. Local government appears as a future holder of own-source revenue, chiefly property tax collected by the revenue authority and shared with counties; the systems named are the authority's own. Nothing is stated about a connection at a local government office.
